english_description: Fires once every 1 second. Like Russian roulette, attacks can be empty shots until a real shot is fired. Empty shots count as normal attacks and are marked as miss. A real shot always hits, ignoring miss chance, then requires a fixed 2-second reset period before repeating the cycle.
chinese_description: 每 1 秒射擊一次，跟俄羅斯輪盤一樣有機會空槍，一直到射中為止。空槍算正常攻擊，並被標註為 miss。實際開槍必定命中，不受 miss 率影響，並且需要固定 2 秒的重置期，重置後往復以上循環。

english_description: After taking 4 weapon damage events, immediately attack once and consume half {stamina}. Damage over time such as {poision} does not count toward the received attack count.
chinese_description: 每受到 4 次武器傷害事件後，立即攻擊一次，消耗一半{stamina}。{poision}等持續傷害不計入受到攻擊次數。

english_description: Each attack has a 50% chance to apply +1 {poision} to the opponent.
chinese_description: 每次攻擊時有 50% 的機率造成對手 +1 {poision}。

english_description: While {hp} is above 50% of {maxHp}, gain +20% {weaponRes}. While {hp} is at or below 50% of {maxHp}, this weapon has -50% {attackSpeed} and +200% {atk}.
chinese_description: 當{hp}高於{maxHp}的 50% 時，自身{weaponRes} +20%。當{hp}低於或等於{maxHp}的 50% 時，此武器的{attackSpeed} -50%、{atk} +200%。

english_description: Whenever this weapon attacks, the opponent also attacks you once with a Dueling Spear. Your Dueling Spear attacks restore {hp} equal to 75% of the damage they deal.
chinese_description: 每次使用此武器攻擊時，對手也會使用決鬥長矛反擊你一次。你的決鬥長矛攻擊會回復相當於該次造成傷害 75% 的{hp}。

english_description: This weapon's {hitRate} is fixed at 95%. If it misses, the wielder suffers Ultimate Humiliation, pausing all attacks for 3 seconds.
chinese_description: 此武器的{hitRate}固定為 95%。若此武器攻擊未命中，使用者受到「終極羞辱」，暫停所有攻擊 3 秒。

english_description: After each attack, gain 1 stack of Charge, up to 4. Attacking with 4 stacks consumes all Charge, makes that attack deal 2.5 times damage, and guarantees a hit. You also take damage equal to half of that attack's damage.
chinese_description: 每次攻擊後獲得 1 層蓄能，最多 4 層。擁有 4 層蓄能時發動攻擊，消耗全部蓄能，使該次攻擊造成 2.5 倍傷害且必定命中；自己同時承受該次攻擊傷害的一半。

english_description: On hit, reduce the opponent's attack damage by 25% for 3 seconds. Refreshes the duration but does not stack. Whenever a single damage event deals more than 25% of your {maxHp} to you, reduce the stacks of your most-stacked negative status by 50%.
chinese_description: 攻擊命中時，使對手的攻擊傷害降低 25%，持續 3 秒，可刷新但不疊加。單次傷害事件中受到超過自身{maxHp} 25% 的傷害時，使自身層數最多的一種負面狀態減少 50% 層數。

english_description: Whenever you are attacked, this weapon has a 25% chance to make an additional attack that costs no {stamina} and ignores all resistances.
chinese_description: 每次受到攻擊時，有 25% 機率使此武器額外發動一次攻擊，不消耗{stamina}，且無視所有抗性。

english_description: Each attack grants 1 stack of Spin. Each stack multiplies this weapon's attack interval by 0.9. If you have insufficient {stamina} when attempting to attack, clear all Spin stacks.
chinese_description: 每次攻擊獲得 1 層轉速。每層轉速使此武器的攻擊間隔乘以 0.9。攻擊時若{stamina}不足，清空所有轉速層數。
